records.label: Pass self zip
records.source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 40 / PDF p. 41; prose continues printed p. 41 / PDF p. 42. 2014 edition sequence text cross-checked at PDF pp. 23–24.
records.notation: Siteswap 726; Prechac 3.5p31. Ben: pass self zip; Anne: pass self zip.
records.notes: Ben starts at time 0; Anne starts 1.5 beats later. Each 3-event odd sequence is repeated twice across a 6-beat cycle to preserve hand parity. For each event, target time is source time + notation height − 2; pass routes to the partner and self/zip to the same juggler. Backward zip edges are retained with signed cycle offsets.
variants: Asynchronous two-person pattern; the three-token sequence is repeated twice per 6-beat cycle.
records.reviewStatus: 2017 source diagram and sequence visually checked; 2014 sequence text cross-checked. All six event nodes per juggler have one exact causal edge; edge timing rule matches the one-beat-back zip loops and signed offsets survive editor validation.

limitations.reason: These require multiple events for one juggler at the same time. The current editor can store distinct nodes, but its lane rendering and table projection overlap/collapse them; they are not ordinary asynchronous zip rows.
The source describes a finite entry/excited-repeat/exit, not a single steady-state cycle.
